answer: A bond is refunded only after 16 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The oasis counter is kept in gale and zephyr shows each reset. Someone therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 16 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 1856 identities would post 1452 proofs and burn roughly 84 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
